facts.fact: MININTER says the minister launched the E-taxe communal tax solution on 23 August 2024 in 12 named pilot communes and wants a launch in every commune by the end of December 2024.
MININTER says the Ministry of Interior developed the E-taxe solution to manage communal taxes, with CRDB Bank as the digital collection interface.
MININTER thanks UNDP for the financial support to E-taxe.

systems.platform: digital communal tax management, CRDB Bank interface
